entries.title: HFU IPSE
entries.facts: IPSE stands for Institute for Product and Service Engineering at Furtwangen University (HFU), Germany. The G1 visitor-assistance thesis is associated with IPSE. Specific laboratory activities must be confirmed by authorized staff.

entries.title: Unitree G1 and G1 Studio
entries.facts: G1 is a physical Unitree G1 EDU humanoid robot used for a master's thesis on interactive customer assistance, guidance, and demonstrations. G1 Studio is the operator-side software platform. Visitor conversations and physical robot speech have been demonstrated. Autonomous guidance and object manipulation are still under development; do not claim they are available.

entries.title: Coffee machine destination
entries.facts: The coffee machine is a planned visitor-guidance destination in the HFU laboratory. The visitor-facing app can show a navigation preview, but this knowledge entry does not authorize or initiate physical robot movement. Real guidance must be controlled and safety-validated in G1 Studio.

entries.title: 3D printing area
entries.facts: 3D Printing is one of the laboratory destinations presented in G1 Remote. Exact equipment details and visitor access rules have not yet been verified.

entries.title: Computer area
entries.facts: Computer Area is one of the laboratory destinations presented in G1 Remote. Specific equipment and visitor access details have not yet been verified.
